guidance.heading: Q4 2026 Business Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026 ending December 31, we are forecasting:
•Revenue in the range of $1,315 million to $1,385 million.
•GAAP gross margin in the range of 55.2% to 55.8%.

•Non-GAAP gross margin in the range of 55.5% to 56.1%, which excludes the impact from stock-based compensation and related expenses as well as the impact from amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets.
•Total stock-based compensation and related expenses in the range of $121.0 million to $125.0 million including approximately $3.8 million that would be charged to cost of goods sold.
•GAAP operating expenses between $334.0 million and $342.0 million.
•Non-GAAP operating expenses in the range of $216.8 million to $220.8 million. This estimate excludes stock-based compensation and related expenses in the range of $117.2 million to $121.2 million.
•Interest and other income in the range from $7.8 million to $8.2 million before foreign exchange gains or losses.
•Fully diluted shares outstanding in the range of 48.9 to 49.3 million shares.

Furthermore, in October 2026, our Board of Directors authorized an additional $500 million for stock repurchases, bringing our total current authorization to $1 billion after repurchases made during the third quarter of 2026.
